title.zh: 手动走完一次前向计算
title.en: Walk through one forward pass by hand

prompt.zh: 不直接调用 `model(input_ids)`，而是用 GPT-2 的各个部件依次完成嵌入、12 层 block、最后的归一化和 unembedding，得到 logits。然后取最后一个位置，算出概率最高的 5 个 token。测试会把你的 logits 与模型自己的输出逐项比较。
prompt.en: Without calling `model(input_ids)`, use the parts of GPT-2 to do the embedding, the 12 blocks, the final normalization and the unembedding in turn and obtain the logits. Then take the last position and compute the 5 most probable tokens. The tests compare your logits with the model's own output entry by entry.

hints.zh: 位置编号用 `torch.arange(T)` 生成，`t.wte(input_ids)` 和 `t.wpe(positions)` 的结果直接相加，形状会自动广播。
hints.en: Create the positions with `torch.arange(T)`. Add `t.wte(input_ids)` and `t.wpe(positions)` directly and broadcasting takes care of the shapes.

hints.zh: 循环里写 `x = run_block(block, x)`。12 层结束后是 `model.lm_head(t.ln_f(x))`。
hints.en: Inside the loop write `x = run_block(block, x)`. After the 12 layers comes `model.lm_head(t.ln_f(x))`.

hints.zh: logits 的形状是 `(1, T, 50257)`。预测下一个 token 只用最后一行，即 `logits[0, -1]`。
hints.en: The logits have shape `(1, T, 50257)`. Only the last row predicts the next token, `logits[0, -1]`.
